rows.title: Copy of Newspaper Publication
rows.summary: Kaveri Seed Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication in Business Standard (English) and Nava Telangana (Telugu) dated 05th September, 2026 intimating the Shareholders about dispatch (through e-mail only) of the Notice of 39th Annual General Meeting of the Company to be held on Tuesday, 29th September, 2026 at 12.00 Noon through Video Conference (VC)/ Other Audio Visual Means (OVAM) and Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26, e-voting information and Book Closure dates.
